title: Max Account Pricing Discrepancy Between Platform and Billing System
body: **Bug Description** _I guess this is not the right place for this bug. It is also reported in the Claudia repo._ I am on the Max subscription ($100). On two computers, there is Claude Code connected to the same account. On both, `/cost` and `/status` confirm that I am on the Max account. On one computer, which I use as my main one, I see that Claude shows my usage as $450. On the other computer, where I installed Claude code today and ran a few commands, my usage is $2. I hope this is a mistake and I won't have to pay for something that should be included in my subscription :) **Environment Info** - Platform: darwin - Terminal: iTerm.app - Version: 1.0.43 - Feedback ID: 1e85a673-c514-437e-b106-d536321141fe This is a machine: This is another one: API console:
